reuse.why: Hooks into the existing pre-link guard that all six providers already call, so no call sites are added, though it re-queries the account that linkBankSyncAccount loads later.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule exists once and nothing is copied.

placement.why: The closed-account check is folded into assertBankAccountNotLinked, whose name and purpose are the one-link-per-bank-account rule, so an unrelated precondition hides inside it instead of in its own guard or in linkBankSyncAccount.

scope.why: The existing test for the unchanged 'already linked to another account' rule was rewritten into a closed-account test, dropping coverage of a rule the request says is unchanged.

maintainability.why: Works through a single path, but the misnamed guard and the lost test of the other rule make the code harder to read and to keep correct.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account handlers
